title: METR finds Anthropic may have crossed its own AI acceleration warning threshold back in July
summary_raw: Nonprofit METR spent eleven weeks auditing Anthropic's internal research data and concluded that the pace of model development has roughly doubled, with about 80 percent of the speedup driven by AI-assisted research. Anthropic redacted the most informative evidence, though, which means the public has to rely on METR's judgment "much more than would be ideal." There are also skeptical voices inside the company. title: No AI agent scores above 12 percent on SemiAnalysis' new real-world work benchmark

title: Tencent releases Hy4 with vision and computer use, claims second place among Chinese AI models
summary_raw: Tencent has unveiled Hy4, its first multimodal language model that understands images and can operate software on its own. On the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, it scores 35 points, solid but behind Kimi K3.1 Pro. On hard math and complex image analysis, Hy4 still trails the best commercial models by a wide margin, according to Tencent itself. title: Meta buys AI coding startup Conductor as big tech races to lock in developers
summary_raw: Meta is acquiring AI coding startup Conductor, which lets developers control multiple AI coding agents at once. On the same day, OpenAI announced plans to acquire Pierre Computer, and Anthropic already bought Stainless back in May. The deals follow a pattern: AI models are becoming interchangeable, and the value is shifting to the tools built around them.
